title: 이라크 사막 이스라엘 비밀 군사기지 위성영상 공개
snippet: Satellite imagery and investigative reports reveal covert Israeli military facility in Iraq's western desert (Al-Anbar governorate, ~180km W of Najaf). Late Feb 2026 imagery shows 1.5km improvised airstrip inside wadi. Early March imagery shows tents, helicopters, military vehicles. Base housed SAR/special forces for Operation Roaring Lion. Flash flooding March 25-30 rendered facility inoperable.
tag_reason: First appearance. Major defense OSINT event — satellite-revealed covert military infrastructure.

entities.name: Israeli Covert Base in Iraq Desert
